known_issues.zoompan_comma: ffmpeg zoompan z expr cannot use min(a,b) because comma is filter separator. Use if(lte()) instead.
known_issues.tts_import_chain: importing TextToSpeechTool from custom_tools triggers trafilatura→justext→lxml_html_clean chain. Write standalone API caller to bypass.

known_issues.wrong_subtitle_approach: 曾用 ffmpeg drawtext/SRT 烧录字幕，产出完全不对——没有顶部栏、没有徽章、没有章节标题、字幕风格错误。必须走 Remotion colorkey 三段式。

known_issues.subtitle_removed: v22+ 去掉旁白同步字幕，底部只留章节钩子行。SubtitleOverlay.tsx 需去除此前的字幕层。

cover.design_philosophy: 平面设计驱动 + 深层隐喻视觉。不用字面翻译主题，用隐喻制造'先被画面吸引、再被文字点破'的认知快感。画面和内容灵魂深度贴合。

visual_metaphor.principle: 每张封面选一个核心隐喻，让画面本身成为内容的视觉寓言。隐喻要优雅、有解读空间、不是直白的图解。
visual_metaphor.forbidden: 禁止字面翻译：如'一半是AI'禁止直接画半真半假的手机屏幕、'割韭菜'禁止画菜地和镰刀。必须找到更高维度的视觉等价物。

examples.AI课割韭菜: 镀金鸟笼 — 笼子很美门开着，不是关鸟而是关人
examples.AI幻觉: 水中月 — 天上无月，光从水底来，幻象不需要真实源头
examples.AI让你更累: 金仓鼠轮 — 轮子本身是艺术品，但你在上面停不下来
examples.短视频一半是AI: 丝绢花丛 — 真花假花同一束光下，不凑近分不清
examples.AI提问效果差10倍: 钥匙与锁 — 同一把钥匙方向不同，结果天差地别

style_references.core_dna: 原研哉的空 + Irving Penn的光 + Apple的排版 — 三者交集形成的独特风格，克制但有力，朴素但精致

still_life_photography.what_to_reference: 纯黑或纯白底上的单物体摄影。单光源从一侧或上方打来，深阴影。把日常物品拍出纪念碑式的庄严感和雕塑感。花卉系列(Flowers)和香烟系列(Cigarettes)最接近我们的花卉/物件类隐喻。
植物微距摄影先驱。极简居中构图，将自然形态拍成建筑般精确的结构。用于丝绢花丛等植物隐喻封面时参考其构图美学。

graphic_design_typography.what_to_reference: MUJI艺术总监，'空'(Emptiness)的美学哲学。大量留白、物体居中、让物体自己说话而非用文字抢夺注意力。文字排版极简克制，用空间的分配而非装饰来定义品质感。
'少，但更好'(Less, but better)。几何无衬线字体选择、功能性排版、金色或银色作为唯一点缀色的逻辑都来自博朗的工业设计传统。

brand_visual_systems.what_to_reference: 暗黑背景(#000)+产品单光源+San Francisco字体的精准排版。0.5px极细金线和宽字距(wide tracking)直接参照Apple的排版规范。
超写实物件+暗底+戏剧性单光，科技感但不是科幻感。抽象隐喻的视觉语言，把眼镜拍成艺术装置而非商品。
深色底+精致排版+克制的金色点缀。精致的朴素感(A refined austerity)。白色空间和深色背景之间的张力。

style_references.prompt_usage: 生成封面prompt时，将上述参考融入描述中。例如：'Composition like Irving Penn's single-object studies on black background. Typographic restraint of Kenya Hara's MUJI. The precision of Apple's product page layout. Single dramatic key light. No text clutter — let the object breathe.'

audio_spec.note: All audio tracks (TTS, BGM, original) must be normalized to this spec before concat. Doubao TTS outputs 24000Hz mono by default - must transcode immediately after synthesis. Use ffmpeg: -ar 48000 -ac 2 -c:a aac -b:a 192k. mp3 use libmp3lame, aac/m4a use aac codec.
audio_spec.ffconcat_requirement: ffconcat demuxer requires identical audio spec across all segments; mismatch causes audio corruption sounding like noise

capsule_config.tts_post_process: after TTS synthesis, immediately normalize: ffmpeg -i tts.wav -ar 48000 -ac 2 -c:a aac -b:a 192k tts_normalized.m4a

loudness_normalization.note: Normalize each segment separately before concat to eliminate loudness jumps between segments

capsule_config.content_rule: identify specific visual/narrative elements in the video that can be replaced by an advertised product; tell viewers they can replace [specific element] with their product to achieve [certain promotional effect]; do NOT recommend any specific software or products; end with: 关注我！一键生产客制化爆款视频！为自己的产品提提鲜！; do not mention original creator name
capsule_config.duration_constraint: total video MUST be <= 37s; TTS script ~130 chars at 1.3x speed = ~22-24s; opening 8s fixed; total ~30-32s with buffer
capsule_config.tts_script_guidance: keep narration script to ~130 chars (Chinese); at 1.3x speed this yields ~22s narration; total with 8s opening <= 35s
capsule_config.audience: general viewers interested in viral content creation
capsule_config.structure: 2-segment: 8s original clip (with audio, title_badge.png at overlay=20:20 - 金黄色斜体主标题+点赞量/转发量白字副标题（纯文字无emoji）, 半透明黑色背景, 无边框/相框) + analysis segment (blurred bg gblur=20 + clear center 624x1109 with gold border #FFD700 4px + thin mosaic 1/6 on subtitle area + TTS narration at volume=4.0 + ASS subtitles Default style MarginV=180 + title_badge.png overlay=20:20 + BGM volume=0.135 + EBU R128 -14 LUFS loudness normalization per segment)
